rows.text: The Council's own news page reproduces Royal Order A/54 of 3/3/1438 AH: the Council consists of 'معالي الشيخ الدكتور عبدالله بن محمد بن إبراهيم آل الشيخ' as Chairman and named members for four Hijri years beginning 3/3/1438 AH.
